channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey introduces ElastiCache Insights
item.description: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey now features ElastiCache Insights, a pre-built dashboard in Amazon CloudWatch for your node-based clusters. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports index-level encryption
item.description: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports index-level encryption, letting you encrypt each index at rest with its own AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Transfer Family supports custom ports for public SFTP servers
item.description: AWS Transfer Family now lets you configure custom ports on public SFTP servers and choose a communication mode for each port. You can support clients that require different ports or start SFTP connections differently on a single server. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Secrets Manager adds managed external secrets support for Databricks and Twilio
item.description: AWS Secrets Manager now extends its managed external secrets capability to include Databricks and Twilio, enabling you to automatically rotate the credentials that your data pipelines and messaging applications use to call these services. (1 source: aws)
